name: benchReplace
description: benchReplace evaluates models' ability to perform targeted text replacement and editing in context, providing source texts with spans to be replaced and expected replacements. It measures both correctness of the replacement and fluency of the edited output, useful for edit-based generation, controlled rewriting, and text repair tasks.
reputation: A small, specialized Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing usage for benchmarking text-editing and span-replacement capabilities.
